article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- — Nasir Mann had 20 points in Queens' 107-74 victory against Gardner-Webb on Wednesday night. Mann also contributed six rebounds for the Royals (4-5). Avantae Parker scored 18 points and added five rebounds. Chris Ashby had 14 points and went 5 of 10 from the field (4 for 8 from 3-point range). Jacob Hogarth, Aaron Talbert and Spence Sims each scored 15 points for the Runnin' Bulldogs (0-10). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
